title: Independent Xitsonga Water Harvesting ordinary-prose semantic backcheck
reviewLimit: Model-level semantic/source backcheck only. I am not claiming Xitsonga fluency, Shangani equivalence, local farming approval, or production readiness. Retained English technical terms and machine-draft grammar still require fluent review.

nativeSourceAndResolverBackcheck.moduleDescriptionSourceComparedAgainst: Swales, berms, dams, rainwater tanks and greywater — slow, spread and sink every drop.

protectedMeaningReview.notes: some, may/can, likely, all/every, any, none/no, only, and not-guaranteed claims were checked row by row; row 64 requires repair because a spatial reading of any is possible.
before-digging/construction/reuse, if/when triggers, first-flush order, local advice, and intended-use limits were checked.

level contour vs slight controlled grade, runoff vs stored/supply water, dry spell vs drought, source vs spring, property vs farm, watercourse vs river, downstream receiving ability, erosion vs breach, dam bank and sink-every-drop wording were explicitly reviewed.
Four lessons each retain 8/9/13/5 item counts and source/current correct indices [1,1]; candidate fields do not reorder options. Quiz semantics screened against unchanged English source.
False options retain their false proposition and polarity. Row 50 is held because the Xitsonga reading of ntsengo could be price or amount.

rows.sourceEnglish: One kind of swale is a level trench on contour. It slows and spreads runoff so some water can soak into suitable soil. Other swales are designed with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Which approach fits your land depends on the soil, slope, drainage and storm flow. Have a trained local adviser check the line, overflow and receiving point before digging.
rows.currentTarget: Muxaka wun'we wa xisele (swale) i a level trench on contour. Wu nonokisa mati lama khulukaka (runoff) wu tlhela wu ma hangalasa, leswaku some water can soak into suitable soil. Swisele swin'wana swi dizayiniwa with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Ndlela leyi faneleke ndhawu ya wena yi titshege hi misava, ku rhelela, ku humesa mati na ku khuluka ka mati ya xidzedze. Kombela mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a leteriweke leswaku a kambela line, overflow na receiving point u nga si cela.
rows.proposed: Muxaka wun'we wa xisele (swale) i a level trench on contour. Wu nonokisa mati lama khulukaka (runoff) wu tlhela wu ma hangalasa, leswaku mati man’wana ma kota ku nghena eka misava leyi faneleke. Swisele swin'wana swi dizayiniwa hi a slight, controlled grade, leswaku swi rhwala excess water hi ku nonoka ku ya eka outlet leyi hlayisekeke. Ndlela leyi faneleke ndhawu ya wena yi titshege hi misava, ku rhelela, ku humesa mati na ku khuluka ka mati ya xidzedze. Kombela mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a leteriweke leswaku a kambela line, overflow na ndhawu leyi mati ma amukeriwaka eka yona u nga si cela.
